Story: AWS to Launch Saudi Cloud Region in December 2026 with HUMAIN AI Zone
Verified angle: Amazon Web Services (AWS) announced at LEAP 2026 that its first cloud infrastructure region in Saudi Arabia will launch in December 2026.
